findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure cookie configuration
 * @description Cookies without secure or httponly flags can be vulnerable to theft
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-cookie-config
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-614
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::AttrRead attr
where
  (
    attr.getAttributeName() in ["set_cookie", "set"] and
    call.getFunction() = attr and
    (
      not exists(call.getArgByName("secure")) and
      not exists(call.getArgByName("httponly"))
    )
  )
select call, "Cookie set without secure or httponly flags."
findings.hypothesis: Looking for cookies being set without secure or httponly flags which could lead to cookie theft

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of weak cryptography
 * @description Using weak cryptographic algorithms or insecure random number generators
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-crypto
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string msg
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() and
    msg = "Use of weak cryptographic hash function"
  ) or
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "choice", "shuffle"]).getACall() and
    msg = "Use of non-cryptographic random number generator"
  )
select call, msg
findings.hypothesis: Checking for use of weak cryptographic algorithms (MD5, SHA1) or non-cryptographic random number generators that could be used for security purposes

message.text: Use of weak cryptographic hash function

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Information disclosure through exception messages
 * @description Sensitive information in exception messages can be exposed
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/sensitive-data-in-exception
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-209
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string sensitiveName
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("raise").getACall() or
    exists(Raise r | call.asExpr() = r.getException())
  ) and
  exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
    arg = call.getArg(_) and
    (
      arg.asExpr().toString().toLowerCase().matches("%password%") or
      arg.asExpr().toString().toLowerCase().matches("%token%") or
      arg.asExpr().toString().toLowerCase().matches("%secret%") or
      arg.asExpr().toString().toLowerCase().matches("%auth%") or
      arg.asExpr().toString().toLowerCase().matches("%key%")
    ) and
    sensitiveName = arg.asExpr().toString()
  )
select call, "Exception message may contain sensitive information: " + sensitiveName
findings.hypothesis: Exception messages that contain sensitive information like passwords, tokens, or keys could leak data
